annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EC) No 78/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 January 2009 on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to the protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users, amending Directive 2007/46/EC and repealing Directives 2003/102/EC and 2005/66/EC
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EC) No 78/2009 on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to the protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament; Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 35/1, 4.2.2009
annotation.summary_en: EU regulation setting EC type-approval requirements for M1/N1 motor vehicles and frontal protection systems to protect pedestrians. It covers passive-safety impact tests, makes brake assist systems mandatory, and allows a possible exemption for collision avoidance systems after Commission assessment. It amends Directive 2007/46/EC and repeals Directives 2003/102/EC and 2005/66/EC. It is not about AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mandatory type-approved brake assist systems in new M1 and N1 vehicles
Pedestrian impact test limits (legform and headform) for bumpers, bonnets and frontal protection systems
Vehicles with collision avoidance systems may be exempted from passive tests after Commission assessment
Phased refusal of type-approval and bans on registration of non-compliant vehicles, 2009–2019
Member States must set penalties for false declarations and falsified test results
